notes.title: December 28, 2024 update details

tags.balance_change: [*] Operational blocks fall a little faster;

tags.feature: [*] New: Error Message Box displayed when making a calculation error;

tags.balance_change: [*] Combo achievements have had their requirements reduced from (x10, x20, x30, x40) to (x5, x10, x15, x20);

tags.feature: [*] The bonus for collecting extra coins can now be unlocked in any mode;
[*] NEW: Sound and visual effect when collecting extra bonus coins;
[*] NEW: "Advanced Mode" option. When this mode is activated, the response signal change and confirmation are done automatically.
[*] Now on the phone icon there is a small guide for beginner players;
[*] NEW: Button for a mini tour added to the game menu. Some areas of the game are presented to the player;

notes.title: December 11, 2024 update details

tags.bug: - [b]Online leaderboard[/b] now correctly displays players from page 2 onwards;
- Player enumeration in the [b]online leaderboard[/b] now starts from "#1";

tags.balance_change: - Back button re-adjusted in the [b]online leaderboard[/b];

- Global Top 100 Table Page Control Enabled.
